title: Scripts and measurements for an audit of receptor preparation in molecular docking
description:
Scripts and complete measurement tables for an audit of the receptor preparation steps that precede molecular docking.

A resolution-stratified sample of 100 single-chain protein crystal structures from the RCSB PDB was prepared with PDB2PQR 3.8.0 under three heteroatom-removal conditions, and with Meeko 0.8.0 under two of them, with and without its bad-residue flag, and under both default-altloc settings. The deposit records the resulting titration states, the residues on which the two tools assign different formal charges, the effect of Meeko's bad-residue flag and of the default altloc setting, and the difference in electrostatic potential the two charge sets produce on the receptor contact surface.

Intermediate files (pqr and pdbqt, 205 MB) are not included; their sha256 checksums are, so that regenerated intermediates can be verified against the ones measured here. See README.md for the two-stage reproduction procedure and environment.md for the tool versions and the network conditions each measurement was made under.

The companion audit of partial-charge assignment for metallomacrocyclic ligands is a separate deposit.
